name: week
title: Affiliate review this week
subtitle: Private working copy. Decisions stay with the operator.

sections.title: Due for attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due_on nulls first,reference

sections.title: Pending decisions
sections.sql: select source_event_id,partner,offer,currency,payout_cents,overdue_days from conversion_review where decision='pending' order by due_on,source_event_id

name: partners
title: Partner amounts by currency
subtitle: Recorded amounts only. No payment instructions.

sections.title: Reviewed and pending amounts
sections.sql: select partner,currency,conversions,pending,approved_payout_cents,approved_margin_cents,pending_payout_cents from partner_balances order by partner,currency

sections.title: Disclosure evidence to review
sections.sql: select partner,placement,market,outcome,review_on from disclosure_review order by partner,placement

sections.title: Open disputes
sections.sql: select c.source_event_id,d.reason,d.owner,d.due_on from disputes d join conversions c on c.id=d.conversion_id where d.status='open' order by due_on
